name: Teaching Design
reason: Educator-led project co-founded in 2019 by Lisa Baumgarten and Anja Neidhardt-Mokoena; current newsletter identifies Baumgarten as curator and editor with named guest collaborators. Public issues reviewed include citation practices (August 2025), museums (July 2025), project-based learning (April 2026), and body-based education (May 2026). The project explicitly uses intersectional-feminist and decolonial perspectives. It connects bibliographic references, classroom exercises and teaching reflections; it is not a peer-reviewed journal or an accredited program. DRS Digital Library independently confirms the related 2025 NORDES exploratory paper and its 16-student case study, DOI 10.21606/nordes.2025.44, under CC BY-NC 4.0. That paper license does not cover the newsletter or bibliography. Reviewed newsletter issues are publicly readable without payment; no blanket reuse license established. Direct access to the separate bibliography website failed, so its full contents and current access remain unverified. Searches for the project name and both domains found no existing repository entry.
next_action: Suitable for one parent resource under Education & Research and Research & Reference, with Design Education and Research, History & Education classifications. Resolve the canonical bibliography destination before describing that collection as fully verified; the newsletter is a verified public access point. Do not import individual issues or past workshops. For our research, examine credit and authorship, the translation from readings to teaching activities, and transparent distinctions between exploratory evidence and proposed methods. This review record does not add a public directory listing.
